# Prezi

> > AI-powered presentation software offering Prezi Present, Prezi Video, and Prezi Design with integrations for Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and Webex.

Prezi is a presentation platform that uses AI to help users create engaging, non-linear presentations with a zoomable canvas. The platform includes three main products and emphasizes hybrid work collaboration, video presentations, and AI-powered design capabilities.

## Key Topics

- Prezi AI
- Prezi Present
- Prezi Video
- Prezi Design
- AI presentation maker
- Zoomable canvas
- Video conferencing integrations (Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Webex)
- Hybrid work presentations
- Business presentations
- Presentation templates
- Visual presentations
- AI-powered design
- Online presentation tools
- PowerPoint conversion
- SOC2 compliance
